newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zellweger says to buy Neotronics.
newsitem.headline: Zellweger says to buy Neotronics.

text.p: Zellweger Luwa said it planned to acquire Neotronics Technology Plc by bidding 90 pence per share for all the outstanding stock in a transaction worth 23.3 million pounds.
"The Neotronics Technology board recommends accepting the formal offer that Zellweger Luwa will make to shareholders within 28 days," it said in a statement.
"The company is confident the offer will be successful," it added. "Neotronics shareholders with a stake of 60.5 percent have already approved the purchase."
The deal must still be approved by cartel authorities.

Neotronics makes portable gas warning systems as well as devices to analyse air and water quality. It posted a pre-tax loss of 680,000 pounds in the year ended on September 30, 1995 on sales of 20.1 million pounds.
